buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses SCOPE OF THE WORK 1. The OEM/System Integrator (SI) shall provide detailed project planning , installation, configuration, testing, performance, security checks, and validation as per the agreed specifications. 2. The scope shall include the installation and commissioning of the stor age, including racking, stacking, cabling, etc., of the supplied hardware . 3. The OEM/SI is responsible for compatibility testing to ensure seamless integration of new storage with existing infrastructure. 4. The OEM/SI must ensure that there is no loss to the existing data and take necessary precautions to protect data privacy, and such actions s hall be their responsibility. 5. The OEM/SI must ensure that the proposed solution meets or exceeds the specified performance standards and is free of defects. 6. Final acceptance of the project will be granted only after successful co mpletion of all tests and upon meeting performance benchmarks speci fied in the contract. 7. The OEM/SI must provide complete documentation for the solution pro

posed and configurations, including troubleshooting guides and mainte nance instructions. 8. The OEM/SI must install and support the application listed in the tende r for 5 years, including updates. 9. Any additional accessories, network devices, cables, connectors, etc., required for installation will be within the scope of the bidder at no extr a cost to the Institute. 10. The OEM/SI is responsible for training relevant staff on the operation a nd maintenance of the proposed solution and must obtain prior permis sion from the Institute’s authorities for any downtime if needed. 11. The OEM/SI will be held liable for any damages or disruptions caused by improper installation, configuration, or failure to comply with agreed standards. 12. The migration of the data from existing DDN Storage to the newly pro posed storage shall be under the scope of the successful OEM/SI at no extra cost to the institute. 13. The Data Centre has rack space to accommodate the proposed solutio n, so the proposed solution shall be fitted into the existing racks only. 14. The prospective bidder(s) may visit the Data Centre at his own conve nience with prior intimation to the concerned authority to ascertain the exact requirement. Please refer buyer uploaded ATC for complete specificati ons and T&Cs. For Procurement Goods & Services a) Compliance (acceptance/non acceptance) with each of the technical specifications as mentioned in the bid document should be separately indicated on a document and evidence presented for each of them (Pr oduct brochures/catalogue should be highlighted wherever required). (b)Supply of the same model should have been carried out by at least 03 reputed public research institutio ns in India. Satisfactory user certificates from 3 of them should be presented. This should be uploaded und er ATC document(s) as required in the bid. (c)Fall Clause: Fall clause is a price safety mechanism. A declaration as per the format given below is to be given by the supplier on their letterhead. FALL CLAUSE NOTICE CERTIFICATE This is to certify that we have offered the maximum possible discount to you in our Bid No.________dated _ ______ The prices charged for the stores supplied should under no event be higher than lowest prices at which th e party sells the items of identical description to any other Govt. organisation/PSU’s/Autonomous bodies/Pv t. Organisations during the period of contract failing which the “FALL CLAUSE” will be applicable. In case, if the price charged by our firm is more, RCB will have the right to recover the excess charged am ount from the subsequent/unpaid bill of the supplier. Seal and Signature of the tenderer. Note: This letter of authority should be on the letterhead of the quoting firm and should be signed by a per son competent and having the power of attorney to bind the same. (d) It is hereby informed that the warranty shall be 'on-site'. Vendors are requested to take note of the sa me before quoting.

(e) For detailed specifications vendor may refer to Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Document. If there is any contravention in the specifications published on GeM and those in the ATC document. Requirements as eli cited in the ATC Document shall prevail. Bidders are requested to quote accordingly. (f) The vendor has to upload an undertaking on their letter head declaring full acceptance of the bid terms and conditions including the ATC's. Non-compliance of the same will lead to disqualification of the bid. (g)Bidder may be asked to show a demonstration of the quoted product if the purchasing department so d eems fit. In case no demonstration is provided, the seller shall be rejected. Post the demonstration, decisio n of the RCB technical sub-committee shall be final. (h)The product should carry a warranty of 3 years. Mention of any other value in the bid document in this r egard may be ignored. Vendors are requested to quote their prices accordingly. No later queries or dispute s in this regard shall be entertained. (i) For detailed specifications please refer buyer uploaded document. (j)Technical Evaluation strictly be done on the basis of Buyer added Terms and conditions (k)The Firm Shall submit the EMD in the form of DD/FD/BG in Favour of EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR RCB Payable at Faridabad. (l)The payment shall be made via direct bank transfer or 100% LC after successful installation a nd commissioning of the equipment subject to submission of the BG and confirmation of the same. (m)For any clarifications with regards to the bid, prospective bidders may kindly mail their queries to purc hase@rcb.res.in . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Payment online through RTGS / internet banking in Beneficiary name EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR, RCB Account No. 349301000051 IFSC Code ICIC0003493 Bank Name ICICI BANK LTD. Branch address NCR BIOTECH SCIENCE CLUSTER, FARIDABAD . Bidder to indicate bid number and name of bidding entity in the transaction details field at the time of on- line transfer. Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the Online Payment Transfer along with bid.
